# design-tokens

On-demand reference adapted from the vendored MIT UI/UX Kit. Project policy
and frontend-design govern scope and completion.

Match the app's token representation and naming. Reuse semantic roles and keep
destructive actions, focus, foreground/background, and theme meaning consistent.
For DTCG, ../scripts/validate_tokens.py takes explicit files/directories; include
required aliases. Measure changed color pairs and relevant theme states.
Do not turn a toolkit sample palette or type scale into a migration requirement.
